definitions.explanation: The nerve that carries sound information from the inner ear to the brain. Damage to it causes hearing loss that a hearing aid cannot fully correct.

examples.japanese: {聴神経|ちょうしんけい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{異常|いじょう}→異常：01716_ijou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{見|み}つかった→見つかる：01173_mitsukaru⟧。
examples.english: An abnormality was found in the auditory nerve.

examples.japanese: ⟦{音|おと}→音：00743_oto⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{聴神経|ちょうしんけい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{通|とお}って→通る：01243_tooru⟧⟦{脳|のう}→脳：03537_nou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{伝|つた}わる→伝わる：01961_tsutawaru⟧。
examples.english: Sound travels to the brain through the auditory nerve.

examples.japanese: ⟦{大|おお}きな→大きな：02849_ookina⟧⟦{音|おと}→音：00743_oto⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{長時間|ちょうじかん}→長時間：10165_choujikan⟧⟦{聞|き}き→聞く：00483_kiku⟧⟦{続|つづ}ける→続く：00903_tsuzuku⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧、{聴神経|ちょうしんけい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{傷|きず}つく→傷つく：01934_kizutsuku⟧こと⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: Listening to loud sounds for long periods can damage the auditory nerve.

examples.japanese: ⟦{検査|けんさ}→検査：02707_kensa⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{結果|けっか}→結果：02486_kekka⟧、⟦{難聴|なんちょう}→難聴：18194_nanchou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{原因|げんいん}→原因：01400_genin⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{聴神経|ちょうしんけい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{腫瘍|しゅよう}→腫瘍：23364_shuyou⟧だ⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{分|わ}かった→分かる：00463_wakaru⟧。
examples.english: The examination revealed that the cause of the hearing loss was a tumor on the auditory nerve.

notes:
{聴|ちょう} (hearing) plus ⟦{神経|しんけい}→神経：03257_shinkei⟧ (nerve). Medical vocabulary, but common enough in health reporting and hospital explanations that learners meet it outside textbooks.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {聴神経|ちょうしんけい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{傷|きず}つく→傷つく：01934_kizutsuku⟧: for the auditory nerve to be damaged
- {聴神経|ちょうしんけい}⟦{腫瘍|しゅよう}→腫瘍：23364_shuyou⟧: acoustic neuroma
- {聴神経|ちょうしんけい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{働|はたら}き→働き：03557_hataraki⟧: the function of the auditory nerve

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{視神経|ししんけい}→視神経：30172_shishinkei⟧: optic nerve — the same construction for sight
- ⟦{鼓膜|こまく}→鼓膜：25978_komaku⟧: eardrum — the membrane that vibrates, not the nerve that carries the signal
